decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Document 38 Date 01 September 2019 Time 13:50 2019 BELGIAN GRAND PRIX 29 August - 1 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 32), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), Turbocharger (TC), Motor Generator Unit – Heat (MGU-H), and rear wing assembly have been changed whilst under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 34.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed power unit elements are of a different specification and rear wing assembly has been changed from those used during qualifying, the parts were replaced with the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate as per Article 34.2. As the parts listed above have been replaced and the setup of the suspension has been changed whilst the car was in parc ferme, the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane per Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 34.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
